title: Colours
slide_intent: Connect a palette to recognizable surroundings because familiar city references can make abstract colors meaningful.
strategic_value: Engel yellow, Metro orange and Bus blue can connect Helsinki communications to everyday urban experience.
demonstration: This webpage introduction names urban color references and states that the palette contains 14 colors with no additions allowed.
practical_value: Select from the defined palette instead of inventing a campaign color.

content_islands.spec: Place the city-derived examples and 14-color boundary beneath the heading.

ingredient.role: Connect communications with recognizable urban colors.
ingredient.application: Choose from the 14 defined colors; do not add new colors.
ingredient.scope: City visual-identity palette; the introduction does not specify proportions or color values.
